title: Retire-or-keep the redundant RunnerSim/RunnerBootstrap standalone demo (superseded by MECH_03 CORRE)
description: Filed from TASK-059 review (rev-t059 LOW-4). MECH_03 ¡CORRE! (V2/CorreMicrogame.cs) now implements the canonical v2 runner mechanic, mined FROM RunnerSim.cs. The original RunnerSim.cs/RunnerState.cs + Framework/RunnerBootstrap.cs (the standalone single-player runner DEMO) are still live — RunnerBootstrap.cs:114,253 consumes RunnerSim, and RunnerSimTests still exercise it — so they are NOT dead code, but they are now REDUNDANT with the production Corre mechanic. Decide: (a) RETIRE the RunnerSim/RunnerState/RunnerBootstrap demo + its tests (like the TASK-061 legacy-id retirement — code preserved in git history), or (b) KEEP it as an intentional standalone demo. If retire: remove the Core sim + state, the Framework bootstrap MonoBehaviour + any scene wiring (Unity-gate for the Framework/scene parts), and RunnerSimTests; grep-prove no dangling references; fast suite green. If keep: add a one-line doc noting it is an intentional demo distinct from the production MECH_03. Not a blocker on TASK-059 (which closed green). Coordinate the Framework/scene deletion with a Unity-gate window if retiring.
acceptance_criteria: A retire-or-keep decision for RunnerSim/RunnerState/RunnerBootstrap is made and recorded (redundant-with-MECH_03 rationale).
If retired: Core sim+state+RunnerSimTests removed with no dangling references (grep-proven); Framework/RunnerBootstrap + scene wiring removed via the Unity gate; fast suite green.
If kept: a doc note marks it an intentional standalone demo distinct from the production MECH_03 CORRE microgame.
